card.name: Digits and links inside numeric ranges
card.fires_on: Responds to a digit or a small linking word (to, and, in) inside a number or range, such as a range of days, ages or doses, in clinical text. It often sits partway through a two-digit number.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A digit within a multi-digit number in a dose, range or day count.

modes.label: Linking word in a range
modes.description: The word to or and between two numbers in an age, duration or count.
